diagnosis: The approve_underwriting action looks up CommercialLoanApplication directly by pk on the unfiltered model manager rather than calling self.get_object(). While the method verifies the FSM transition can proceed, it does not verify that the loan belongs to request.user's assigned bank branch. A loan officer in Branch A can trigger underwriting approval on multi-million dollar corporate loans submitted to Branch B.
